name.baseName: Disposal, wood pole, chrome preserved, 20% water, to municipal incineration

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: This dataset represents the activity of waste disposal of waste wood pole, chrome preserved in a municipal solid waste incinerator (MSWI) Recommended use of this dataset: For disposal of bulk or small parts of chrome preserved wood poles as used for electricity grids. Please note there is another, slightly different chrome preserved wood for genereal building products. Waste composition (wet, in ppm): upper heating value 15.36 MJ/kg; lower heating value 13.99 MJ/kg; H2O 173450; O 370840; H 49982; C 400020; S 288.79; N 983.43; P 108.57; B 58.919; Cl 329.76; Br n.a.; F 21.03; I n.a.; Ag n.a.; As 0.42061; Ba n.a.; Cd 0.19979; Co 0.086459; Cr 2281.5; Cu 786.37; Hg 0.31861; Mn 52.927; Mo 0.82721; Ni 0.5538; Pb 27.767; Sb n.a.; Se n.a.; Sn n.a.; V n.a.; Zn 17.743; Be n.a.; Sc n.a.; Sr n.a.; Ti n.a.; Tl n.a.; W n.a.; Si n.a.; Fe 15.423; Ca 130.42; Al 6.3093; K 65.176; Mg 196.85; Na 334.08; Share of carbon in waste that is biogenic 100%. Share of metals in waste not oxidised and bulk-recyclable (exclude very small or thin parts) Iron: 0%; Alu: 0%; Copper: 0%. One kg of this waste produces 0.01088 kg of slag and 0.004415 kg of residues, which are landfilled. Additional solidification with 0.001766 kg of cement. Net energy production: 1.74MJ/kg electric energy and 3.49MJ/kg thermal energy. Recovery of metal scrap to recycling: 0g iron scrap, 0g aluminium scrap, 0g copper scrap.;; UUID: 9c0372d8-d97f-418e-a734-adb0ab6c9a6c

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: Waste composition as given in literature reference, theoretical data or other source. Transfer coefficients for modern MSWI.

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Specific to the technology mix encountered in Switzerland in 2010. Well applicable to modern incineration practices in Europe, North America or Japan.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
average Swiss MSWI plants in 2010 (grate incinerators) with electrostatic precipitator for fly ash (ESP), wet flue gas scrubber and 25% SNCR , 42.77% SCR-high dust , 32.68% SCR-low dust -DeNOx facilities and 0% without Denox (weighted according to mass of burnt waste, representing Swiss average). Efficiency of iron scrap separation from slag : 58%. Efficiency of non-ferrous scrap separation from slag : 31%. Gross electric efficiency technology mix 15.84% and Gross thermal efficiency technology mix 28.51%

# Included processes
Waste incineration from waste reception gate further downstream (excluding transport to the MSWI plant). Waste-specific air and water emisions from incineration, auxiliary material consumption for flue gas cleaning. Short-term emissions to river water and long-term emisisons to ground water from slag compartment (from bottom ash) and residual material landfill (from solidified fly ashes and scrubber slugde). Waste-specific process energy demands for MSWI and net energy generation.
